purpose: Local candidate data only. Not a Wrangler configuration; never auto-loaded by the Worker or build.
unverified: Cloudflare verification of temporary test recipient

required_before_enable.CONTACT_TO: User-designated temporary recipient for separately approved real-send testing, not a confirmed store production destination. Cloudflare destination verification is unconfirmed. Local tests substitute a synthetic address and send no mail.
required_before_enable.EMAIL: A restricted send_email binding whose destination_address equals CONTACT_TO; unrestricted sending is not approved.
required_before_enable.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY: Register the dedicated production Secret outside source control after approval.
required_before_enable.data-sitekey: Set the dedicated public Site Key on the production CONTACT form only after approval; currently blank.
required_before_enable.CONTACT_RATE_LIMITER: Approve a production-only namespace and threshold; do not reuse staging 31001 or negative 31002.
required_before_enable.activation: Separate explicit approval, production build review, and real verification are required. Candidate values do not enable sending.
